sources.name: Xbox Wire
sources.title: DMZ — 5 Features to Get Excited for in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4’s New Mode
sources.text: Call of Duty’s upcoming DMZ mode sounds like it’s shaping up to be something special. Set on the new Hajin map and inspired by the events and locations from Modern Warfare 4 ’s Campaign, this open-world combat environment will challenge you to loot, complete objectives, fight both enemies and rival Operators, and extract before everything you’ve earned is lost. Recent intel drops on the official Call of Duty Blog have given us a much clearer picture of what awaits in Hajin when DMZ launches as part of Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 . Players who have digitally pre-ordered or pre-purchased Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 can gain Early Access to the game’s Campaign starting Friday, October 16 and all of DMZ starting Tuesday, October 20. The events within DMZ are set after the main MW4 Campaign, leaving a power vacuum in its wake. Now it’s up to you to identify a new, mysterious threat and dismantle its operations across the DMZ through various deployments. From scavenging for crafting materials and experimenting with new technology, to leveling up an Operator, the mode sounds like it offers plenty to look forward to. Here are five features to get excited for when you begin your deployment. The 3D Printer will be available back at the Forward Operating Base (FOB) between deployments and will serve as your primary crafting station to build equipment and upgrades for your loadout before you drop into Hajin. The Call of Duty Blog shares that , as you progress through the DMZ, you’ll unlock new crafting recipes to create more powerful equipment – as well as upgrades to the 3D Printer and even the Forward Operating Base itself. Recipes can also be found on deployments and, presuming you extract in one piece, you can then craft those items for your Operator back at the FOB. When focused on crafting new equipment, the two key things you’ll be looking for when looting on deployments will be Resources and 3D Printer Ingredients – these are the two types of main elements to craft all items. There are four basic Resources to find during a deployment: Synthetics, Electronics, Chemicals, and Metals, automatically broken down from looted items, into your Backpack and Stash. 3D Printer Ingredients are rarer materials found in specific areas of Hajin and are valuable as an ingredient to make a new Item. Examples include Binding Catalyst, Biomaterials, Detonators, and Control Units, to name a few. Once you have enough of these two types of materials, you can select how many copies of an item you want to craft at once, then choose where crafted items go: send completed items directly to your Stash for later or equip them directly to your Operator to quickly prepare for the next deployment. Having this flexibility in how you want to engage the enemy during your deployment can open a variety of experiences in DMZ and can make each deployment feel like it matters, even if you come back to the FOB with zero kills to your name – at least you’ve got handful of electronics or a comms module to make it worth your time. Extraction shooters are always more engaging when every deployment has a clear purpose. That’s not going to be problem with DMZ as it will offer three ways to deploy: Story Missions, Dynamic Operations, and Free Roam. Of those, Story Missions and Dynamic Operations are two that really stand out with their defined objectives and high-tier rewards. According to the Call of Duty Blog , Story Missions will feature narrative-led deployments that you can complete and replay, though some remain locked until prerequisites are met. Each entry provides briefing intel, required objectives, and rewards – usually high-value gear and DMZ Cash – along with options for a random mission and additional milestone rewards. Dynamic Operations, meanwhile, give squads multiple goals to pursue within the DMZ. After deploying, you choose an operation and complete its objectives to earn DMZ XP, Cash, and the ability to call in a Supply Drop filled with unpredictable loot. That extra payoff adds anticipation to every successful Op while making Dynamic Operations a promising source of both Cash and XP. Persistent Operators may be DMZ’s most exciting feature because they allow Hajin to leave a lasting mark on you. You’ll begin with two Operator slots, and unlock a third as you progress through DMZ levels. Each Operator then grows stronger by surviving deployments and earning DMZ XP. Each successful exfil levels up your Operator’s Dog Tags, and this is the key to gaining Trait Points for your Operator. You can invest those points across the Warfighter, Scout, and Survivalist Trait Trees, creating a meaningful choice between specialization and flexibility: with a maximum of 18 points to earn, and a choice of over 60 Trait Points to augment your Operator, you can tailor each Operator to your skills and preferred role. For example, Warfighter Traits include Combat Resistance, Quick Fix, and Viper Sense; Scout Traits include improved Thermal Padding, UAV Upgrade, and Field Crafting; while Survivalist Traits include Faster and Free Revives, increased Consumable Duration, and many more. But here’s where it gets dicey: if an Operator fails to extract and becomes MIA, you must either recover them with DMZ Cash or dismiss them. Because recovery costs rise with Trait investment, bringing back a high-level Operator becomes increasingly expensive. Recovered Operators keep their Traits but lose their gear, putting real weight behind every deployment. The chase for loot is at the heart of every extraction shooter, and DMZ makes each haul matter beyond the current deployment. Returning to base with a pack full of supplies doesn’t just feel rewarding – it improves your chances of success the next time you enter Hajin. Once you drop into a deployment, looting should be a top priority. Searching containers provides resources for combat, supports marked Operations, strengthens your position in Hajin, and offers a reliable way to earn DMZ XP and adva

sources.title: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 Launch Rollout Adds DMZ Early Access
sources.text: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 has added DMZ to its list of early access experiences available for pre-order players ahead of its launch later this month. Activision and Infinity Ward revealed a host of new details for its DMZ revamp in a blog post shared today. Early access for the mode joins campaign early access , with both available to those who pre-ordered either the standard or Vault Edition versions of the game across PC, Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation 5, and/or Xbox Series X/S. Here's the full breakdown: Eligible players will gain early access to the Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 campaign starting Friday, October 16. DMZ early access will then follow Tuesday, October 20, with the full launch unleashing the rest of the experience come Friday, October 23. All of the new details arrived with a new gameplay trailer for DMZ, which you can see below. DMZ was first introduced as Call of Duty's take on the extraction shooter experience with 2022's Modern Warfare 2 . It was expanded upon in the months that followed but was ultimately deemed to be an underwhelming prototype by many. Support ended in late 2023, and now, Activision is taking another swing at it. The DMZ in Modern Warfare 4 has been propped up as a fully fleshed-out evolution for the game mode. In today's post, Infinity Ward described the new take on the mode as the series' "definitive extraction shooter experience," promising persistent progression in the open-world combat environment known as the Hajin Exclusion Zone. "There's an interesting story with the DMZ beta, where we had to make some decisions," studio multiplayer creative director Joe Cecot said in a recent behind-the-scenes video (below). "Certain things we wanted to do, we couldn't do. At the end of the day, we learned a lot: That we made a very approachable, fun sandbox that was fun to fight in, to explore, to make friends in, to get into fights in. There's a bunch of stuff we left on the table, so as soon as we finished with the last game, we were just gung-ho on, 'OK, we know what we want to do.'" Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 launches October 23 for PC and consoles. Our first proper look at DMZ gameplay arrived in June, with even more details shared earlier this week. While early access players will get to dive into DMZ and the story mode a few days earlier than others, core multiplayer offerings won't officially launch until that firm release date hits. You can see how the team at Infinity Ward is working to deal with wall-hack cheaters here . Michael Cripe is a freelance writer with IGN. stories.title: GTA 6 Leaker Threatens to Release Build With Full Story Mode Played to the End, Ties Lucia's Clothing to Crypto Scheme
stories.summary: The GTA 6 leaker has reportedly threatened to release a build of the game with the full story mode played to the end, as part of their heavily criticized crypto scheme.

sources.name: IGN
sources.title: GTA 6 Leaker Threatens to Release Build With Full Story Mode Played to the End, Ties Lucia's Clothing to Crypto Scheme
sources.text: The GTA 6 leaker has reportedly threatened to release a build of the game with the full story mode played to the end, as part of their heavily criticized crypto scheme. According to online reports , the Cyberleek website was updated with a warning that if its memecoin reached a market cap of $30 million, a build of GTA 6 would be released featuring the full story mode including end credits. In the alleged online warning, Cyberleek once again framed their GTA 6 leaks as a protest against the lack of a physical disc version of the game, and allegedly called on Take-Two to release GTA 6 on-disc and issue an apology. It is unclear whether Cyberleek intends to release a build of the game online, or means to release a full playthrough of GTA 6 in video form. A cryptocurrency market capitalization (market cap) is the total dollar value of all the coins or tokens of a digital asset currently in circulation. At the time of this article’s publication, Cyberleek had a market cap of $3.8 million, having spiked at $5.7 million earlier today as reports of the message hit social media. It seems unlikely that it will get anywhere near $30 million. Cyberleek also issued market cap goals tied to the clothing Lucia would wear in subsequent leaked gameplay. For example, at $2 million, Cyberleek threatened to release gameplay showing Lucia wearing a bikini. According to Cyberleek, a $4 million market cap would mean releasing gameplay with Lucia “fully naked.” However, there is significant skepticism about Cyberleek’s support of physical media, with many accusing the leaker of running a cryptocurrency scam. Fans have heavily criticized Cyberleek and anyone who spends money on their memecoin. “What a dork,” one person said. “Anyone who puts money into this deserves to lose it all.” Cyberleek appeared to go dark after a spate of high-profile GTA 6 leaks in August that sparked an investigation from Rockstar parent company Take-Two. The film issued subpoenas to the likes of Discord as part of the hunt for the person or group of people responsible. But Cyberleek reemerged this week with the release of a 24-minute GTA 6 gameplay video that showed cutscenes, story beats, playable characters Jason and Lucia naked (in the case of Jason, full-frontal nudity), and a first-person camera. It remains unclear how the gameplay footage, or any potential build of the game it's taken from, escaped the confines of Rockstar's infamous tight security. This week’s developments suggest Cyberleek remains at large and defiant in the face of potential legal action. In August, Rockstar addressed the GTA 6 leaks , describing the situation as "heartbreaking" for its development team and "unfortunate" for fans. At the time, the developer acknowledged that its intended experience for players "may now be impacted by some spoilers," but reiterated GTA 6's previously-confirmed launch date of November 19. Analysis of cryptocurrency transactions in late August pointed to the GTA 6 leaker having "cashed out," earning around $270,000 in the process. Every video posted by Cyberleek pointed to a website where fans could pay to vote on further leaks using the leaker's own cryptocurrency. Such a poll is reportedly live on Cyberleek's website now , suggesting yet another leak is on the way. Whether the culprit or culprits are ever caught may rest on how successful Take-Two's legal team and the relevant authorities are at forcing social networks or crypto exchanges to divulge any personal details they hold on those responsible. Wesley is IGN's Managing Editor. Find him on Twitter at @wyp100. You can reach Wesley at wesley_yinpoole@ign.com or confidentially at wyp100@proton.me.

sources.name: Eurogamer
sources.title: GTA 6 leaker CyberLeek is now reportedly threatening to release a full, playable build of the game
sources.text: A GTA 6 leaker has reportedly threatened to put out a complete, playable build of the game, start to finish. The threat was posted on CyberLeek's website after the leaker shared 25 minutes of footage from the game earlier this week. Rockstar has previously issued statements regarding the leaker, noting that the leaks are "heartbreaking" and that "this is obviously not how we intended for you to see the game after all this time". Take-Two, Rockstar's parent company, has been hunting for the person behind the leaks, and has tried to subpoena Discord for information pertaining to the leaker's identity. After going quiet for a bit, CyberLeek came back with a bang this week, posting new footage from Rockstar's upcoming game that even features nude scenes, including a fully naked Jason, and a topless Lucia. Eurogamer has seen the video, and it appears to be legitimate - and, as is now traditional, has CyberLeek's emblem overlaid on top of the footage. CyberLeek now reportedly says the build will go out if their cryptocurrency coin reaches a market cap of $30 million, and claims it can be played through to the end credits. "Here's the deal, nice and clean," the demand reads. "CyberLeek hits 30 million marketcap, the build goes out — full story mode, played to the end, credits and all. Don't believe it has full story mode? Ask for what you want to see, and it gets provided. Take-Two gets one way out: physical disks and a public apology. They can take it at any moment. Or they can gamble that CL is bluffing. Everyone knows which one they'll pick." GTA 6 is due out on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S on 19th November.

sources.name: PC Gamer
sources.title: GTA 6 leaker threatens to upload a build with 'full story mode'
sources.text: "Take-Two gets one way out: physical disks and a public apology." Cyberleek has been uploading footage of Grand Theft Auto 6 since August, most recently a 25-minute video featuring co-protagonist Jason totally nude . Given that GTA 6's November 19 release is just over a month away, on console at least, it seems natural that interest in these kinds of leaks would wane. Cyberleek has found a new way of generating hype: promising to leak a build of the game if their memecoin's marketcap goes up another $26 million or so. "Here's the deal, nice and clean. CYBERLEEK hits 30 million marketcap, the build goes out – full story mode, played to the end, credits and all. Don't believe it has full story mode? Ask for what you want to see, and it gets provided. Take-Two gets one way out: physical disks and a public apology. They can take it at any moment. Or they can gamble that CL is bluffing. Everyone knows which one they'll pick." The other half of the deal suggests that publisher Take-Two Interactive could prevent this by releasing GTA 6 physically and apologizing, presumably for not releasing it on discs in the first place. Which will never happen, but does fit with Cyberleek's previous history of cosplay Robin Hood consumer rights complaints. We know that Cyberleek has access to a playable build since one of the previous leaks ended with the word LEEK being machinegunned into a wall to prove the point. But an early build of GTA 6 seems like the worst possible way to play it on PC, though after the Xbox streaming thing turned out to be a bust , maybe there are people who don't want to wait? sources.title: GTA 6 leaker threatens to release a build of the entire game start to finish
sources.text: The notorious GTA 6 leaker known only by their online moniker Cyberleek is back with a new threat. Should their memecoin's market cap hit $30 million, Cyberleek says they'll release a start-to-finish playable build of Rockstar Games ' long-awaited open worlder. Cyberleek's threat, posted to their website and reposted elsewhere online, also gives parent company Take-Two an ultimatum of sorts. The leaker says Take-Two can make this whole fiasco go away by printing physical GTA 6 discs and issuing a public apology. "Here's the deal, nice and clean. CYBERLEEK hits 30 million marketcap, the build goes out — full story mode, played to the end, credits and all," the leaker writes on their website. "Don't believe it has full story mode? Ask for what you want to see, and it gets provided. Take-Two gets one way out: physical disks and a public apology. They can take it at any moment. Or they can gamble that CL is bluffing. Everyone knows which one they'll pick." This isn't the first time Cyberleek's made demands around physical games. An older manifesto railed against practices such as digital pre-orders, "fake" single-player DLC and code-in-a-box physical editions - though game preservation group Stop Killing Games disagreed with the leaker's methods : "Using illegal means to make a point is unacceptable to us and does nothing to protect our right to keep using what we paid for." The latest drama comes days after Cyberleek released roughly 24-minutes of new GTA 6 footage showing everything from a first-person mode to a nude Jason and in-game racing events. An even more recent leak supposedly features gameplay from a topless Lucia's perspective. GTA 6's history with leakage goes back years, though the Cyberleek saga only kicked off in earnest earlier this summer when the hacker - or hacking group - shed light on the game's map well before its Netflix blowout. Many thought the drama would've ended when Cyberleek squeezed $250,000 out of their crypto scheme before going radio silent for weeks. Rockstar previously addressed the leaks and called them "heartbreaking for our team," while warning that any leaked footage might contain spoilers. Weekly digests, tales from the communities you love, and more GTA 6 shows Jason nude, and fans are wondering if Rockstar will go full Red Dead Redemption 2: "Those horse balls physics gotta go somewhere" Kaan freelances for various websites including Rock Paper Shotgun, Eurogamer, and this one, Gamesradar. sources.title: GTA 6 Leaker Threatens To Release Full Game Build Before November Launch
sources.text: Cyberleek is back with its biggest GTA 6 leak-related threat yet Cyberleek returned last week with a wave of new Grand Theft Auto 6 leaks, and is now making their biggest leak threat yet. Cyberleek claims it will leak a finished build of the game if Rockstar doesn't meet their conditions. Cyberleek terrorized Rockstar Games for weeks by leaking footage of Grand Theft Auto 6 earlier this year. It leaked gameplay from early builds of GTA 6 , story missions, and in-game locations, and more. Cyberleek was quiet through September, but started leaking again last week, showing nude versions of characters like Jason. In late August, Grand Theft Auto 6 publisher Take-Two Interactive had enough and started hunting down the hacker. It subpoenaed Discord and Microsoft to find more information about Cyberleek's identity and whereabouts. It looked like Take-Two was closing in on Cyberleek, and when the leaker disappeared for nearly a month, it seemed like the company had caught up to them. Now, it's clear that Cyberleek won't disappear quietly Cyberleek claims it has a full build of GTA 6 and will release it to the public if its cryptocurrency reaches a $30 million market cap. However, it apparently won't release the build if Take-Two agrees to give GTA 6 a physical on-disc release and apologizes publicly. Since the start, Cyberleek has claimed it's leaking the game because it's angry that GTA 6's physical release will be just a code in a box, and it believes gamers have the right to own physical media for what they play. There's clearly a financial incentive to what they are doing as well, since their leaks have been directly tied to cryptocurrency the leaker can profit from, so it's ultimately a big crypto scheme . As of this writing, $CYBERLEEK sits at a $6 million market cap, and it's been rising since the leaker's offer went live. It is highly unlikely that Take-Two will meet the leaker's demands, especially so close to launch. If Cyberleek truly isn't bluffing, all we can do now is sit and wait to see what happens.

sources.title: Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls Officially Adding Thor, Venom, and Jubilee Next Year
sources.text: Arc System Works revealed three more DLC fighters coming to the game in 2027 Arc System Works and Sony Interactive Entertainment have unveiled the rest of the Year 1 DLC characters for Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls at EVO France. The first one to arrive after Phoenix Cyclops is a surprising pick. Instead of adding Thor Odinson to the tag fighter's roster, the developers chose Jane Foster's Thor. The trailer that debuted Jane Foster's Thor as a fighter also revealed the full Year 1 DLC lineup. Phoenix Cyclops kicks things off on Nov. 2. Then, in 2027, we can expect Thor (Jane Foster) to launch in the Winter, Venom in the Spring, and X-Men character Jubilee in the Summer. It's a strong group of DLC characters that come from different corners of the Marvel universe. While we didn't see any gameplay featuring Jane Foster's Thor, the trailer does show her confronting Loki in Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls ' Asgard stage. This won't be the first time Jane Foster's Thor has been playable in a video game, as she was one of Marvel's Avengers ' last post-launch characters in 2022. Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls has shown a willingness to subvert expectations with its roster picks, featuring Shuri's Black Panther rather than T'Challa's and the Phoenix Force-infused Cyclops rather than the regular version. Venom is a fairly mainstream pull, though, and he'll join the game alongside a new Klyntar stage. As a fan of X-Men: The Animated Series and X-Men '97 , I'm most hyped for Jubilee's addition. She's already a lot of fun in Marvel Rivals , and I can't wait to see how Arc System Works adapts her flashy powers for its gorgeous fighting game. Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls is available on PlayStation 5 and Windows PC. To access these DLC characters, you'll need to buy the $84.99 Digital Deluxe Edition or the base game plus the $34.99 Year 1 Character and Stage Pass.

Reviva momentos fiéis ao filme no Modo História ou mergulhe no mundo aberto do Velho Oeste de Woody’s Roundup no Modo Caixa de Brinquedos. Volte ao quarto de Andy ao lado de Woody, Buzz Lightyear e outros personagens clássicos em Toy Story: Retro Roundup! Esta coleção de cinco jogos inclui versões para consoles e portáteis de quatro dos primeiros títulos de Toy Story , além de Vida de Inseto . sources.title: Xbox Game Pass recebe Gears of War E-Day e mais jogos esta semana! Veja os lançamentos (10)
sources.text: Gears of War E-Day é bom? Confira review com o novo exclusivo do Xbox e PC O Xbox Game Pass é um dos serviços de assinatura de games mais democráticos da atualidade, já que é possível acessá-lo de diferentes plataformas — incluindo os próprios, consoles da Microsoft, assim como no PC, nuvem, celulares, tablets e até Smart TVs Samsung e LG com modelos de 2022 para cá. Felizmente, seu catálogo também é atualizado quase que semanalmente, trazendo inúmeras opções para os assinantes aproveitarem — e o melhor de tudo: gastando pouco em comparação às novas tendências de preços da indústria. Se veio em busca de novos jogos para jogar através do Xbox Game Pass , está no lugar certo. O serviço ganhou um reforço de peso esta semana com a chegada de quatro títulos para os assinantes aproveitarem. Confira abaixo mais informações sobre as novas aventuras! Gears of War: E-Day é uma prequel do primeiro jogo da franquia e acompanha Marcus Fenix e Dominic Santiago durante o Dia da Emergência, 14 anos antes dos acontecimentos originais. A campanha mostra o surgimento da Horda Locust e o início da batalha pela sobrevivência da humanidade. O game aposta na ação brutal característica da série, com uma história focada na origem dos personagens e do conflito contra os Locust. Gears of War: E-Day chegou no primeiro dia ao Xbox Game Pass. Echo Weaver é um metroidvania com foco em exploração, conhecimento e manipulação do tempo. No papel do último Tecelão, o jogador precisa aprender com cada ciclo temporal e utilizar as anomalias para encontrar uma forma de quebrar a repetição. A aventura combina exploração e resolução de mistérios, fazendo com que as informações obtidas durante as tentativas sejam parte essencial da progressão. O jogo também chegou no primeiro dia ao Xbox Game Pass. Forever Ago acompanha Alfred, que parte em uma viagem pelo norte após uma tragédia que muda sua vida. A aventura solo é centrada na exploração de diferentes lugares, no encontro com novos personagens e na busca por redenção. Durante a jornada, o jogador poderá registrar momentos com uma câmera, conhecer pessoas e construir novas amizades. Claro, Forever Ago também chegou ao Xbox Game Pass no primeiro dia. Por fim, Neon Abyss 2 combina plataforma e ação roguelike em um cenário cyberpunk repleto de elementos pixelados. Na pele de um personagem lançado em Nova Atenas, o jogador precisa enfrentar o Abismo e diferentes ameaças enquanto busca vingança. A experiência é construída em torno de tentativas sucessivas, com a morte fazendo parte da progressão. Cada derrota permite uma nova oportunidade de explorar o Abismo e avançar em meio aos desafios. stories.title: Magic: The Gathering Darkhold Destiny Panel – Everything Announced
stories.summary: Earlier this year at MagicCon in Las Vegas, Wizards of the Coast revealed its in-universe sets for 2027, but that only covered three of the six planned sets. The other three are Universes Beyond — the card game's crossover brand — and now we know about another one, Darkhold Destiny, the new Marvel set.

sources.name: IGN
sources.title: Magic: The Gathering Darkhold Destiny Panel – Everything Announced
sources.text: Wizards of the Coast just announced Magic: The Gathering Darkhold Destiny , its latest Marvel set in a New York Comic Con panel. This is the third Marvel collaboration for the card game, but where the first two were about presenting super heroes as they already exist in Marvel canon, Wizards of the Coast was able to cook up its own storyline for Darkhold Destiny. The set revolves around the likes of Doctor Strange, Thor and Ghost Rider, all trying to work against Hela and Dormammu invading the multiverse. It's a much better thematic fit for Magic: The Gathering, and the early cards have introduced new mechanics like Vengeance, which is like the Adventure mechanic introduced in Throne of Eldraine, but evil . Even though there was a lot of information in this panel, the set doesn't come out until April 8th next year, so there are still plenty of details that WotC is holding close to its chest. And, keep in mind that there are still two more Universes Beyond sets coming next year that we don't know anything about. 8:35 pm: And that's the show. Darkhold Destiny, looks like a cool set, but there's still a lot that Wizards didn't reveal. But it's a decent start! 8:33 pm: WotC announced a special promo or Doctor Doom, King of Latveria for Avengers Doomsday. you'll be able to grab it if you go see the movie at a Regal Cinemas on opening weekend "as long as supplies last". It's the face of the Dr. Doom commander deck, and it's done in the style of the MCU, so I expect it'll go fast. 8:31 pm: One more thing. There will be three Secret Lair drops inspired by Dr. Doom, just in time for the new Avengers movie. They're not revealing which cards are in the drop yet, but there is Dr. Doom art, and they told the crowd "you'll have to guess which reprint this is". I guess we'll wait. 8:26 pm: There are new Secret Lair, a countdown kit, a giant box with 30 cards. This thing is about to cost a lot of money. Most people will get it in nonfoil, but there will be a random chance that you'll get it in traditional foil, and an even more rare chance to get it in surge foil. I guess the Secret Lair booster packs didn't work, but we're at least getting to gamble on whether or not they're foil. The Secret Lair launches November 2nd. 8:22 pm: There will be two bundles, a regular bundle and an 'Arcanum' bundle. Both of these will have their own mechanically unique promo card. Hopefully that card doesn't get too expensive! There are also two scene boxes, also filled with mechanically unique cards. 8:19 pm: For the product suite, we have Booster Packs, Collector Boosters, Prerelease Pack and Draft Night (which also has a Collector Booster). There will also be four commander decks, Strange Academy (WUB), Gods of Asgard (RGW), Midnight Sons (WB) and Lords of Hel (BR). There will also be Collectors Editions for each deck that'll be completely decked out in surge foils. 8:16 pm: The basic lands take after the Adventures From the Forgotten Realms lands, with flavor text that tell the story. Unlike that D&D set, though, each Basic Land type has two variants, one before Hela and Dormammu's invasion and one after. They look awesome. 8:13 pm: One more card, Temple of Khonshu. It's a common black/white land and it enters tapped unless you control a Dimension. Dimension is some kind of new card type, and Wizards is not revealing it yet. I hope they're better than Battles. 8:10 pm: They brought Arcane back, which was a card subtype that hasn't really existed since the Kamigawa block in the 2000s. We got a black modal spell, and a red one "Rise From the Nether" that creates 3/1 creature tokens. Bring back Splice Onto Arcane. 8:08 pm: Hela's card looks awesome, it introduces a new keyword, Vengeance, which is basically just an Adventure that you cast when the card is in the graveyard. So, if Hela is your commander, you can send her to the graveyard when she dies, then put her in the command zone when you cast from the graveyard, and make a little loop. 8:05 pm: They introduced Magik as a dual faced card. WotC didn't add all the X-Men, but Magik fits the vibe of the set, and she looks awesome. She'll be able to transform into Darkchild, and you'll be able to pay 4 life to give her indestructible. So, she'll be pretty hard to kill. 8:03 pm: But even with all the art, there has to be cards. The centerpiece is The Darkhold, a legendary artifact for three mana, and you can tap it, put sin counters on it and draw a card for each sin counter. It's like an evil version of The One Ring. 8:01 pm: The set will be themed around three different types of magic. Arcane for Doctor Strange & Co, Divine for gods like Thor and Dark Magic for villains like Hela and Dormammu. But there are some heroes might be using Dark Magic. 7:57 pm: Once they got the greenlight, WotC had to invent a lot, apparently. The first two sets were about superheroes, but with Darkhold Destiny, the company was much more interested in focusing on villains. So, we've got Hela has a foil to Thor, and the Dread Dormammu as the foil to Doctor Strange. Hela x Dormammu is quite a cool team-up, I'm not going to lie. 7:53 pm: The main heroes of the set are Doctor Strange and Thor, which perfectly fit the theme of the set. And it's not Thor as the Avenger, it's Thor as a god. It sounds like the story really came together after Magic designers pitched their idea for a darker Marvel world. 7:52 pm: There will be new crossover comics, coming out via Infinity Comics. The first issue will be out in February, with another coming closer to the April release. That should introduce people to the world that Marvel and WotC have been building together. 7:50 pm: Now they're showing off some of the art, and it looks just like something out of Innistrad. Ok, well maybe not exactly Innistrad, but very similar vibes. 7:49 pm: Marvel and Wizards have been working on this set together for years. Marvel Super Heroes and Spider-Man it was focused on just getting everyone's favorite characters in the game,

stories.title: GTA 6 Fan Says Rockstar Sent Them a Poster Just Because They Asked Nicely
stories.summary: A Grand Theft Auto 6 fan in Brazil said they politely asked the Rockstar Games team to send them a poster – and it looks like they actually followed through.

sources.name: IGN
sources.title: GTA 6 Fan Says Rockstar Sent Them a Poster Just Because They Asked Nicely
sources.text: A Grand Theft Auto 6 fan in Brazil said they politely asked the Rockstar Games team to send them a poster – and it looks like they actually followed through. Reddit user aogustoo shared their story in a post late last month. What began as a "shot-in-the-dark email" they sent to Rockstar asking for a signed GTA 6 poster has turned into what seems to be a heartwarming moment for them and the community. "A while ago I took a complete shot in the dark and emailed Rockstar," they said. "I shared how hyped I was for GTA VI and asked if there was any chance I could get a poster for my room. "Honestly, I expected an automated reply or nothing at all. To my absolute surprise, an executive actually answered and shipped an official GTA VI poster straight from their New York office to my home in Brazil." You can see images, which show not only the poster but the emails they supposedly sent to receive it, above. As Rockstar (and the rest of the world) count down the days to GTA 6's November 19 launch, fans will no doubt be on the lookout for official merchandise like this. As many have pointed out, it's unclear if Rockstar truly took the time to send the poster, but the community is still looking to the moment as something worth celebrating as the countdown continues. "This is a massive W tho," Rockstar content creator @videotech said on X/Twitter . "This guy isn’t an influencer or someone famous, literally just a random Rockstar fan. Very kind of Rockstar and Take-Two to take the time and effort to do this." "​I blurred out all personal addresses, names, and contact emails to respect their privacy," aogustoo added. "Please don't flood their inbox with requests, as I'm pretty sure this was just a rare act of kindness from someone on their team." There's still so much about GTA 6 that we don’t know, but one thing is for sure: Rockstar will probably get even more emails after this. While we wait to learn more about the next Grand Theft Auto game ahead of its November 19 launch for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S, you can check out IGN's recent interview with Rockstar North's Rob Nelson . You can also read about what Nintendo had to say about the chances of seeing GTA 6 on Switch 2 , some recently revealed radio stations , and even a batch of new screenshots . Michael Cripe is a freelance writer with IGN. He's best known for his work at sites like The Pitch, The Escapist, and OnlySP. sources.title: BlazBlue: Central Fiction coming to PS5
sources.text: Arc System Works will release a PlayStation 5 version of 2015-released fighting game BlazBlue: Central Fiction , the developer announced . The company recently announced that it will release new downloadable content character Trinity Glassfille for the PlayStation 4 and PC versions of the game. The PlayStation 5 version will feature rollback netcode, cross-play with the PC version, four new text languages, and new Training Mode features. Trinity Glassfille’s release will differ from the PlayStation 5 version and language update’s release. BlazBlue: Central Fiction has been released across PlayStation 4, PlayStation 3, Switch, PC via Steam , and arcades.
